minorFinding.rule: STC students choose German, French or Spanish and take both 15 EC minors in that one language. These are restricted choices, not 30 EC of open electives or all three languages.

generalRules.finding: Degree totals 180 EC and includes a 5 EC philosophical component. Fixed faculty minor packages cannot be freely mixed. Open space is bachelor-level breadth; foreign study requires prior examination-board approval. Specific entry conditions govern course access. Attendance rules apply where required. Standard first-year progress norm is 45 EC for initial registration before 31 January; specified later-registration and delayed-advice cases use 60 EC. The thesis cannot ordinarily be exempted; replacement requires the examination board’s specified research-project or internship exception.
generalRules.qualification: Current faculty rules clarify procedure; they do not fill the absent STC B3 table or missing exact final-work and whitepaper records.

specificNoncreditAndAssessment: Specific OER requires attendance for all courses including mentoring, and passing all partial assessments. B1 RADAr and B1/B2 mentoring carry 0 EC; do not count them toward 180 EC or equate them with UCR PPD.
